title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE TWO DEBTORS – DO YOU UNDERSTAND GOD’S FORGIVENESS? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE TWO DEBTORS – DO YOU UNDERSTAND GOD’S FORGIVENESS? 🔥
📖 Luke 7:41-42 – "Two people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty. Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?"

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what does the Parable of the Two Debtors really mean? Is Jesus teaching about money, or is there a deeper lesson?"
🔥 GREAT QUESTION! This parable is not just about debt—it’s about SIN, FORGIVENESS, and TRUE LOVE FOR GOD!
🚨 If you don’t realize how much you’ve been forgiven, you’ll never truly love Jesus!
⚠️ WARNING: Those who think they are "good people" don’t see their need for salvation!
Let’s dive into this powerful parable and see what Jesus was teaching!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE PARABLE OF THE TWO DEBTORS?
📖 Luke 7:41-42 – "Two people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty. Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?"
🔥 JESUS TELLS THIS PARABLE TO TEACH ABOUT FORGIVENESS!

✔️ The moneylender represents God.
✔️ The two debtors represent sinners (ALL OF US!).
✔️ The forgiveness of debt represents God’s mercy in forgiving sin.
💡 The one who was forgiven more, loved more!
🚨 DO YOU REALIZE HOW MUCH GOD HAS FORGIVEN YOU?

🔥 2. THE CONTEXT – WHY DID JESUS TELL THIS PARABLE?
📖 Luke 7:36-39 – "A woman who had lived a sinful life brought an alabaster jar of perfume, stood behind Jesus at His feet weeping, and began to wash His feet with her tears."
🔥 THE STORY BEHIND THE PARABLE:

✔️ Jesus was eating at the house of a Pharisee named Simon.
✔️ A sinful woman (likely a prostitute) entered and wept at Jesus’ feet.
✔️ She poured expensive perfume on His feet, showing her deep love for Him.
✔️ The Pharisee judged her, thinking, "If Jesus were a prophet, He would know what kind of woman this is!"
🚨 RELIGIOUS PEOPLE THINK THEY ARE BETTER THAN OTHERS—BUT THEY DON’T REALIZE THEIR OWN SIN!
💡 DO YOU SEE YOURSELF AS "GOOD" OR AS A SINNER WHO NEEDS GOD’S GRACE?

🔥 3. WHO LOVES MORE? THE ONE WHO IS FORGIVEN MORE!
📖 Luke 7:43 – "Simon replied, ‘I suppose the one who had the bigger debt forgiven.’ ‘You have judged correctly,’ Jesus said."
🔥 THE LESSON:

✔️ The Pharisee thought he was righteous because he followed religious rules.
✔️ The sinful woman KNEW she was broken and needed Jesus’ mercy.
✔️ Jesus was teaching that those who recognize their deep sin will love God more!
🚨 THE MORE YOU UNDERSTAND GOD’S FORGIVENESS, THE MORE YOU WILL LOVE HIM!
💡 DO YOU TRULY APPRECIATE WHAT JESUS HAS DONE FOR YOU?

🔥 4. THE DANGER OF SELF-RIGHTEOUSNESS!
📖 Luke 7:44-46 – "Then He turned toward the woman and said to Simon, ‘Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give Me any water for My feet, but she wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.’"
🔥 SIMON THE PHARISEE REPRESENTS MANY RELIGIOUS PEOPLE TODAY:

❌ He INVITED Jesus into his house, but not into his heart.
❌ He thought he was BETTER than the sinful woman.
❌ He didn’t show LOVE or HUMILITY toward Jesus.
🚨 RELIGION CAN MAKE YOU BLIND TO YOUR OWN SINS!
💡 ARE YOU HUMBLE LIKE THE WOMAN OR PROUD LIKE SIMON?

🔥 5. TRUE FAITH LEADS TO FORGIVENESS AND LOVE!
📖 Luke 7:47-50 – "Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven—as her great love has shown. But whoever has been forgiven little loves little. Then Jesus said to her, ‘Your sins are forgiven.’"
🔥 KEY LESSONS FROM JESUS:

✔️ FORGIVENESS IS AVAILABLE TO ALL, NO MATTER HOW GREAT THE SIN! (Isaiah 1:18)
✔️ LOVE FOR GOD GROWS WHEN YOU UNDERSTAND HIS MERCY! (Romans 5:8)
✔️ RELIGION WITHOUT LOVE IS EMPTY! (1 Corinthians 13:1-3)
🚨 IF YOU THINK YOU DON’T NEED MUCH FORGIVENESS, YOU WILL NEVER TRULY LOVE GOD!
💡 HAVE YOU FULLY RECEIVED GOD’S FORGIVENESS?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: HAVE YOU TRULY REPENTED?
📖 Acts 3:19 – "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Be like Simon—self-righteous and blind to your own sin?
✔️ Be like the woman—humble, repentant, and fully surrendered to Jesus?
🚨 JESUS IS READY TO FORGIVE YOU—BUT YOU MUST REPENT!
💡 DO YOU TRULY UNDERSTAND HOW MUCH YOU HAVE BEEN FORGIVEN?

🙏 PRAYER FOR FORGIVENESS AND LOVE FOR JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I acknowledge that I am a sinner in need of Your grace. Forgive me for every sin I have committed. Thank You for dying on the cross for me. Fill my heart with love for You, just like the woman in this story. Help me to never take Your mercy for granted. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
